authority: Cambridge International AS & A Level Computer Science 9618 syllabus, 2027-2029, Version 2

records.resolution: Adds visible CORE teaching, worked application and two assessment forms for networking benefits and LAN/WAN characteristics.
Teaches computer roles, benefits, drawbacks and scenario justification for client-server and peer-to-peer models.
Distinguishes thin and thick clients by processing, storage, dependency and management consequences.
Covers bus, star, mesh and hybrid topologies in visible CORE teaching and practice.
Explains host-to-host transmission paths and scenario-based topology choice, including hybrid paths.
Directly compares public and private clouds, benefits, drawbacks and a regulated-document choice.
Connects wired/wireless mechanisms to mobility, installation, interference, capacity and security implications.
Covers copper, fibre-optic, radio/WiFi, microwave and satellite with mechanism, use and limitation.
Teaches every required LAN hardware category and replaces a generic assessment with five distinct LAN hardware roles.
Defines routing between networks using destination IP addresses and routing information, separated from WiFi access.
Preserves the exact CSMA/CD sense, transmit, detect, stop, random-backoff and retry sequence with two assessment forms.
Adds direct lesson and quiz assessment of real-time/on-demand bit streaming and broadband-rate constraints.
Distinguishes internet infrastructure from the WWW service in teaching, practice and assessment.
Adds modem, PSTN, dedicated line and cell phone network to visible teaching and two direct assessment forms.
Covers IPv4/IPv6 lengths, subnetting, interface association, public/private, static/dynamic and the security boundary with two assessment forms.
Explains URL resource location and structure, DNS domain resolution and the domain/path boundary.
